title: Best of Singapore & Thailand | A Memorable Journey
highlights: Make your time memorable as you spend an amazing vacation in Singapore and Thailand, covering experiences and attractions from its prominent cities.
Elevate yourself high above Singapore's skyline as you board the iconic Singapore Flyer, known to be one of the world's tallest Ferris wheels.
Visit the beautiful Merlion Park, home to the famous Merlion Statue of Singapore and enjoy views of Marina Bay and the city's skyline from the place.
Admire the beauty of the Emerald Buddha, a revered symbol of Thailand's spiritual and cultural heritage carved from a single piece of jadeite jade.
Dive into the wonders of Coral Island, famous for its breathtaking coral reefs and immerse yourself in the place as you see an array of marine life.
overview:
Singapore happens to be the only island city of Southeast Asia that caters to a wide spectrum of visitors all through the year. Tourists come over to this country to visit the breathtakingly beautiful places of tourist interest, enjoy the lively nightlife, delight their taste buds with the amazing tasting local and international dishes, and satisfy the shopaholic inside them.
Singapore has got a perfect blend of culture and nature heritage all through its expanse and it is evident in all places you visit in the course of this tour. Singapore can be considered as an ideal place for honeymoon couples, family vacationers, adventure junkies as well as food addicts. It is truly a dream come true place that gives you a wonderful experience of life. 
On this tour package, you will also get a chance to spend some time in Thailand, which offer surreal picturesque beauty all around and loads of enthusiastic activities for wanderlust travelers and adventure seekers. You will be visiting its places of tourist interest as well as taking a city tour along with some experienced tour guides.

know_before_you_go: You should carry your passport and visa at the time of arrival.
With the tropical climate in Thailand, staying hydrated is essential. Drink bottled water and avoid tap water to prevent waterborne illnesses.

The currency used in Thailand is the Thai Baht (THB) and in Singapore is Singapore Dollar (SGD) so familiarize yourself with the current exchange rate and ensure you have enough cash or access to ATMs, especially if you plan to visit rural areas.
Adhere to designated smoking areas and respect non-smoking areas, which may include indoor spaces and certain outdoor areas.
Any personal expenses or items of a personal nature will not be included in the package.
Any breakage or damage of any items in the hotel will be charged at actuals.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Singapore
days.desc: Welcome to the Land of the Lions! Upon your arrival at Singapore Airport, get transferred to the hotel. Once you arrive, proceed to check-in and take some rest. In the evening, you can visit the Night Safari, the world's first nocturnal zoo, to encounter wildlife in their natural habitat. Also, you can enjoy a tram tour that takes you through six different parks. Later, you can pay your respects at the Civilian War Memorial before heading back to your hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Singapore Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: In the morning, get ready for an exciting tour of Singapore City. From your hotel, enjoy the pre-booked transfer to the first spot, Merlion Park, to take in the views of the skyline and see the Merlion statue. Next, you'll be taken to City Hall, followed by a visit to Parliament House and more. Also, you will enjoy a visit to the Singapore Flyer, known for offering stunning views of the city, concluding the tour at Chinatown. Afterward, get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Excursion to Sentosa Island
days.desc: Today, you'll be transferred to Mount Faber Station to board a cable car for Sentosa Island. During the ride, enjoy the views of the surrounding landscapes. Once you arrive at Sentosa Island, you are free to explore the SEA Aquarium, Universal Studios and more at your own pace and at an extra cost. Also, if you're feeling adventurous, you can visit the thrilling Adventure Cove Waterpark or simply relax on the pristine beaches before getting transferred to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Arrival in Bangkok | Transfer to Pattaya
days.desc: Post check-out, you'll be transferred to the Singapore Changi Airport to board your flight to Bangkok (flight tickets not included). Upon arrival, board the pre-booked transfer, which will take you to your hotel in Pattaya to check-in and relax. Later, you can head out to explore the Sanctuary of Truth, shop at Pattaya Floating Market or take a walk at the Nong Nooch Tropical Garden. Afterwards, return to your hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Day Trip to Coral Island
days.desc: Today, get ready for an adventurous tour of Coral Island. You'll be transferred to the Bali Hai Pier to board a speed boat to sail towards Coral Island's pristine beaches and turquoise waters. As you reach, enjoy many adventurous water sports like jet skiing, parasailing, snorkeling, and many more. Next, visit Tawaen Beach, for a leisurely walk along the white sandy coastline of the Indian Ocean. Finally, conclude the day with a pre-booked transfer back to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Arrival in Bangkok
days.desc: Today, you'll be transferred from the serene beaches of Pattaya to the bustling streets of Bangkok. Check-out from the hotel and take the pre-booked transfer that will take you to Bangkok. Once you arrive, check-in at your hotel and relax. Later, you can head out to visit the Erawan Museum, Sea Life Bangkok Ocean World, Art in Paradise, or experience the city's vibrant nightlife. End the day with a return journey to your hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Bangkok Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Have an amazing day, as you'll be exploring Bangkok on a sightseeing tour. Your journey will begin with a pre-booked transfer to the first spot of the day, Mahaputtaram Temple, one of the most important shrines in the city. Next, you'll be taken to the temple of the Golden Buddha, followed by a visit to Wat Phra Kaew and the Grand Palace. Conclude the day by enjoying a visit to the Gems Gallery, famous for gem-made jewellery. Later, you'll be transferred back to your hotel for an overnight stay.
